headline: 640 customers were charged the full price after using a coupon
cause: Your app sends the full price to Razorpay after a coupon is applied

answer.title: Coupon orders are paid at the full price
answer.text: Since the coupon campaign opened at 8:30 pm, the order shows the discounted total but the customer's payment is the full price. Razorpay captured exactly what your app asked for.

groups.label: Charged too much
groups.hint: ₹1,18,780 to refund, the gap on each order

compared: Compared with your payments in the same hours the day before
cannot_see: customers who saw the larger charge and cancelled the order

root.cause: The app applies the coupon to the order total but sends the full price to Razorpay, so the payment is larger than the order.
root.fix: Send the discounted amount when the payment is created, and refund the difference.
signals: order and payment amounts differ from 8:30 pm
orders without a coupon matched their payments

actions.title: Refund the difference to 640 customers
actions.text: ₹1,18,780 in all goes back to the customers' original payment methods, each the gap between what they paid and their order total.

actions.title: Send your app team the mismatch list
actions.text: The list has 640 payment IDs, paid amounts and order totals, so the coupon code path can be found.

actions.title: Message 640 customers
actions.text: Tells them the discount was missed, the difference is being refunded, and when to expect it. In your name. It waits until the refund is approved.

explained_from: from the campaign start, with proof
closing: The cause was your app, not Razorpay or a bank. Every action is approved. In this demo nothing was refunded or sent.

rca.title: Root cause: coupon orders are being charged the full price
lines: Whose side: your app code. Confidence: exact, 3 signals agree.
Started: 8:30 pm, when the coupon campaign opened.
Affected: 640 customers charged more than their order total, ₹1,18,780 in all.
Fix: send the discounted amount, and refund the difference.
rca.signed_off: Signed off by Razorpay support at 8:56 pm
